indications.trial_design: Single Phase 2/3 adaptive design study, ~300 patients, composite primary endpoint of death and/or need for dialysis; FDA agreed in late 2025 that positive data would be sufficient for NDA submission
indications.trial_status: PLANNED - infrastructure build during 2026 (CRO selection, advisory board, drug supply manufacturing); company intends to start as soon as feasible
key_milestones: FDA alignment on Phase 2/3 adaptive NDA pathway (late 2025)

indications.trial_name: Evaluation of the Safety and Tolerability of Gemini in Subjects With Stage 3-4 Chronic Kidney Disease
indications.trial_design: Randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 1/2 study of intravenous Gemini in CKD stage 3-4 patients
indications.trial_status: COMPLETED (primary completion 2025-07-22). Company plans repeat-dose Phase 2 study in 2026 pending preclinical toxicology
key_milestones: Repeat-dose Phase 2 planned, contingent on toxicology

excluded_preclinical: Gemini for severe burn / hyperinflammation - preclinical
